name: Shammah
overview: The name Shammah appears in Scripture referring to several individuals, including a son of Reuel mentioned among the chiefs of Edom (Genesis 36:13,17) and multiple warriors in King David's elite company. Notably, Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite distinguished himself by defending a field of lentils against the Philistines, where the LORD granted a great victory (2 Samuel 23:11-12). Other references identify Shammah as one of David's mighty men from various clans (2 Samuel 23:25,33), highlighting his role as a valiant and faithful warrior in Israel's history.
